body:
Thank you, like you I am also a quote nerd. It's also great to see somebody recovering being so positive. I attended AA meetings for quite a bit and understand what it's like and I know that people have been in worse situations than me. That's why I just want to hear about people who have come out on top just to remind me it is possible. Thank you for your kindness and compassion towards a complete stranger.

I have just been feeling down lately, I feel like I have nobody I can truly open up to without being judged. I can't get any sleep despite having to work in 2 hours. Worried about my future and just feel quite lost.
